title: Signal Echo

story.briefing: The Core has gone quiet. Before anything can be repaired, the relay in Sector 1 has to prove it can still speak. Send it a pulse.
story.success: Relay 1 answers. The valley lights up, one node at a time.

description: Return a single string containing the word SIGNAL repeated `count` times, separated by single spaces. If `count` is 0, return an empty string.
hints: A string can be built up piece by piece inside a loop, or produced all at once from a list.
Watch the separator. Joining a list of words with a space avoids a trailing space at the end.
Make a list of `count` copies of "SIGNAL", then join it with a single space. Zero copies naturally joins to an empty string.
